correctness.rationale: For n-element unordered four-symbol vectors x,y, a common three-symbol output exists iff Omega(x,y)=sum min(x_i,y_i)>=3, hence a code is a clique under Omega<=2. Heavy-coordinate packing bounds cardinality by four for n>=9, pure vectors attain; the source checker exhaustively searches nonexistence of cliques of sizes 12,7,6,6,6 at n=4..8. Independently implemented complete increasing-index bitmask clique backtracking and checked absence for each forbidden size, plus the explicit witnesses. Values 20 at n=3, 11 at n=4, 6 at n=5, 5 at n=6..8, and 4 at n>=9 are correct. The finite combinatorial searches prove only finite exceptional sizes, while heavy-coordinate argument proves infinite tail.
